stratagems.name: Adaptive Tactics
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Select one of the following Combat Doctrines: Devastator, Tactical, or Assault. Until the start of your next Command phase, your unit gains the benefits of that doctrine, regardless of what Combat Doctrine is active for the rest of your army.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army equipped with bolt weapons.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack with a bolt weapon, an unmodified Wound roll of 2+ is always successful, and that attack has the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] ability.

stratagems.name: Xenos-killer
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army that is within Engagement Range of a TYRANIDS, ORKS, AELDARI, or T'AU EMPIRE unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack against a unit with any of those keywords, add 1 to the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: Teleport Homer
stratagems.when: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.
stratagems.target: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army that is in Reserves.
stratagems.effect: Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 3" horizontally from all enemy models.
